id./param/scenario/cs/b_070_cs_070.pack|cs_: "Oh, {var:1} and Lord Robert. Do you need something from me?
"Sultan, sorry for the vague question, but do you know of a giant hammer in this kingdom?
"We need it to beat Mordegon. We know it was in Gallopolis in the Age of Heroes...
"A hammer... A hammer... Oh, could you mean the Forging Hammer handed down in the royal family!
"Faris! Fetch the Forging Hammer from the treasure room!
"Yes! This is the hammer Erdwin held in the Heart's memory!
"Father, is it all right? Wasn't this the hammer we planned to sell to a peddler for next year's Faris Cup...
"...Ahem! {var:1}, the Forging Hammer is a precious treasure handed down in Gallopolis since our forefathers.
"But now only you, the Luminary, can beat Mordegon. If you need it, I gladly give it.
"Legend says the Spirit of the Land dwells in that hammer.
"They say striking with it can forge even the hardest metals.
"Well, good luck on your quest to defeat Mordegon. I expect good news!"
